title: Exploring Victorian Public Transport Patronage
text: package includes patronage dataset, containing reported average daily patronage transport mode, day week, day type reporting month. dataset covers January 2018 March 2026. can check reporting period available transport modes: observation represents specific combination reporting month, transport mode, day week day type.
code: data("patronage", package = "victransport")  head(patronage) #>   year month       date day_of_week               day_type             mode #> 1 2018     1 2018-01-01      Monday         Normal Weekday Metropolitan bus #> 2 2018     1 2018-01-01     Tuesday         Normal Weekday Metropolitan bus #> 3 2018     1 2018-01-01   Wednesday         Normal Weekday Metropolitan bus #> 4 2018     1 2018-01-01      Monday School Holiday Weekday Metropolitan bus #> 5 2018     1 2018-01-01     Tuesday School Holiday Weekday Metropolitan bus #> 6 2018     1 2018-01-01   Wednesday School Holiday Weekday Metropolitan bus #>   avg_daily_patronage #> 1              308450 #> 2              359800 #> 3              400250 #> 4              298500 #> 5              295500 #> 6              299950 range(patronage$date) #> [1] "2018-01-01" "2026-03-01"  unique(patronage$mode) #> [1] "Metropolitan bus"   "Metropolitan train" "Regional bus"       #> [4] "Regional train"     "Tram"  unique(patronage$day_type) #> [1] "Normal Weekday"         "School Holiday Weekday" "Weekend"

title: Exploring Victorian Public Transport Patronage
text: package provides exported function summarise_daily_patronage(). function calculates unweighted mean reported average daily patronage values, grouped transport mode, day type day week. resulting table includes: mode: Public transport mode. day_type: Day classification. day_of_week: Day week. mean_daily_patronage: Mean reported daily averages. n_observations: Number reporting observations.
code: patronage_summary <- summarise_daily_patronage()  head(patronage_summary) #> # A tibble: 6 × 5 #>   mode             day_type      day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations #>   <chr>            <chr>         <ord>                      <dbl>          <int> #> 1 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Monday                   329452.             93 #> 2 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Tuesday                  350910.             93 #> 3 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Wednesday                354643.             96 #> 4 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Thursday                 355585.             95 #> 5 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Friday                   334818.             94 #> 6 Metropolitan bus School Holid… Monday                   261829.             45

title: Exploring Victorian Public Transport Patronage
text: can also restrict analysis selected range years. example, following code summarises reported patronage 2022 2025: function can combine filters investigate specific transport modes, day types reporting periods.
code: recent_summary <- summarise_daily_patronage(   years = c(2022, 2025) )  head(recent_summary) #> # A tibble: 6 × 5 #>   mode             day_type      day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations #>   <chr>            <chr>         <ord>                      <dbl>          <int> #> 1 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Monday                   346701.             46 #> 2 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Tuesday                  374896.             46 #> 3 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Wednesday                376818.             46 #> 4 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Thursday                 379020              45 #> 5 Metropolitan bus Normal Weekd… Friday                   355324.             45 #> 6 Metropolitan bus School Holid… Monday                   293798.             20 selected_summary <- summarise_daily_patronage(   modes = "Metropolitan train",   day_types = "Normal Weekday",   years = c(2022, 2025) )  head(selected_summary) #> # A tibble: 5 × 5 #>   mode               day_type    day_of_week mean_daily_patronage n_observations #>   <chr>              <chr>       <ord>                      <dbl>          <int> #> 1 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Monday                   474415.             46 #> 2 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Tuesday                  559966.             46 #> 3 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Wednesday                564504.             46 #> 4 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Thursday                 576732.             45 #> 5 Metropolitan train Normal Wee… Friday                   526151.             45

text: victransport R package provides interactive Shiny application exploring public transport patronage patterns Victoria, Australia. application designed Victorian public transport users anyone interested understanding public transport usage varies across transport modes, days week, day types reporting periods. addresses question: average daily public transport patronage differ across transport modes, days week day types Victoria, patronage changed 2018 2026? Users can explore patterns interactive visualisations, summary statistics dynamically generated key findings.

title: Explore Victorian Public Transport Patronage
text: package uses Victorian Government’s Monthly Average Patronage Day Type Mode dataset. dataset contains monthly observations average daily public transport patronage, categorised : Transport mode: Metropolitan train, metropolitan bus, tram, regional train regional bus. Day week: Monday Sunday. Day type: Normal weekday, school holiday weekday weekend. Reporting period: January 2018 March 2026. original measure, Pax_daily, represents reported average daily passenger patronage recorded category. package, variable named avg_daily_patronage. Data source: Victorian Government, Monthly Average Patronage Day Type Mode. original data obtained official data resource. Important: app calculates unweighted means reported daily averages selected observations. figures interpreted total monthly passenger journeys combined network-wide daily patronage. Reporting coverage may also differ years, particularly 2026, includes data March.
